# Transcriptomics

Preserve the requested method, contrast, identifiers, enrichment source, and
statistical population. These are parts of the estimand, not interchangeable
output formats.

- Match count-matrix sample IDs to metadata before fitting. Confirm the design
  formula, covariates, reference and target levels, and contrast direction.
- Use raw counts for count-model methods unless the named method specifies a
  different input. Do not treat normalized or transformed abundance as counts.
- Use the matched experimental control. Do not replace a vehicle, batch-matched,

/bin/bash -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
# Read DESeqResults without requiring Bioconductor classes.
read_de <- function(p) {
 x <- readRDS(p)
 data.frame(gene=attr(x,'rownames'), attr(x,'listData'), check.names=FALSE)
}
a <- read_de('inputs/res_GluFevsGluFePlus.rds')
b <- read_de('inputs/res_SuccvsGluFePlus.rds')
sig <- function(d) unique(d"'$gene[!is.na(d$padj) & !is.na(d$log2FoldChange) & abs(d$log2FoldChange)>1.5 & d$padj<0.05])
A <- sig(a); B <- sig(b)
# KEGG PA14 current organism pathway membership
lk <- read.delim('"'https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/pau', header=FALSE, col.names=c('gene','term'), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
lk"'$gene <- sub('"'"'^pau:'"', '', lk"'$gene); lk$term <- sub('"'"'^path:'"', '', lk"'$term)
lk <- unique(lk)
nm <- read.delim('"'https://rest.kegg.jp/list/pathway/pau', header=FALSE, col.names=c('term','name'), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
ora <- function(fg, bg=NULL, all_terms=FALSE) {
 if (is.null(bg)) bg <- unique(lk"'$gene) else bg <- intersect(unique(bg), unique(lk$gene))
 fg <- intersect(unique(fg), bg)
 spl <- split(lk$gene, lk$term)
 spl <- lapply(spl, function(x) intersect(unique(x), bg))
 ok <- lengths(spl)>=10 & lengths(spl)<=500
 spl <- spl[ok]
 k <- vapply(spl, function(gs) sum(fg %in% gs), integer(1))
 tested <- if(all_terms) rep(TRUE,length(k)) else k>0
 spl <- spl[tested]; k <- k[tested]
 M <- lengths(spl); N <- length(bg); n <- length(fg)
 p <- phyper(k-1, M, N-M, n, lower.tail=FALSE)
 data.frame(term=names(spl), k=k, M=M, n=n, N=N, p=p, padj=p.adjust(p,'"'BH'), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
}
for (bgmode in c('kegg','deseq')) for (allterms in c(FALSE,TRUE)) {
 bg <- if(bgmode=='kegg') NULL else union(a"'$gene,b$gene)
 ea <- ora(A,bg,allterms); eb <- ora(B,bg,allterms)
 sa <- ea$term[ea$padj<.05]; sb <- eb$term[eb$padj<.05]; ans <- setdiff(sa,sb)
 cat('"'\\nMODE bg=',bgmode,'family=',if(allterms)'all-size-eligible' else 'hit-only', '\\n', sep='')
 cat('mapped fg',ea"'$n,eb$n,'"'background',ea"'$N,'"'sig',length(sa),length(sb),'difference',length(ans),'\\n')
 out <- merge(ea[ea"'$term %in% ans,c('"'term','k','M','p','padj')],nm,by='term',all.x=TRUE)
 out <- out[order(out"'$padj),]
 print(out,row.names=FALSE)
 # Show status in B
 st <- merge(out[,c('"'term','name')], eb[,c('term','k','M','p','padj')], by='term', all.x=TRUE)
 cat('B status:\\n'); print(st,row.names=FALSE)
}
cat('\\nKEGG links',nrow(lk),'genes',length(unique(lk"'$gene)),'"'terms',length(unique(lk"'$term)),'"'\\n')
RS"

/bin/bash -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
read_de <- function(p) { x <- readRDS(p); data.frame(gene=attr(x,'rownames'), attr(x,'listData'), check.names=FALSE) }
fg <- function(d) unique(d"'$gene[is.finite(d$log2FoldChange) & !is.na(d$padj) & abs(d$log2FoldChange)>1.5 & d$padj<0.05])
D1 <- read_de('"'inputs/res_GluFevsGluFePlus.rds'); D2 <- read_de('inputs/res_SuccvsGluFePlus.rds')
L <- read.delim('https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/pau', header=FALSE, col.names=c('gene','path'))
L"'$gene <- sub('"'"'^pau:'"','',L"'$gene); L$path <- sub('"'"'^path:'"','',L"'$path); L <- unique(L)
ora <- function(g, universe) {
 universe <- intersect(unique(universe), unique(L$gene)); g <- intersect(g, universe)
 sets <- lapply(split(L$gene,L$path), function(z) intersect(unique(z),universe))
 sets <- sets[lengths(sets)>=10 & lengths(sets)<=500]
 hit <- vapply(sets, function(z) sum(z %in% g), integer(1)); hit <- hit[hit>0]; sets <- sets[names(hit)]
 pv <- phyper(hit-1, lengths(sets), length(universe)-lengths(sets), length(g), lower.tail=FALSE)
 setNames(p.adjust(pv, method='"'BH'), names(pv))
}
univ <- union(D1"'$gene,D2$gene)
p1 <- ora(fg(D1),univ); p2 <- ora(fg(D2),univ)
s1 <- names(p1)[p1<0.05]; s2 <- names(p2)[p2<0.05]; only <- setdiff(s1,s2)
stopifnot(length(fg(D1))==224L, length(fg(D2))==541L, identical(only,'"'pau01110'))
cat('foregrounds:',length(fg(D1)),length(fg(D2)),'\\n')
cat('significant pathway counts:',length(s1),length(s2),'\\n')
cat('iron-only:',paste(only,collapse=','),' count:',length(only),'\\n')
cat('adjusted p-values for iron-only pathway:',p1[only],p2[only],'\\n')
RS"
